title: A decision can be deprecated; the views show only what stands
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. Decisions were deprecated automatically at a cut's integration.
decision: A decision stands until it is superseded or deprecated. Deprecated is the established status of an architecture decision that no longer applies and has no replacement: a later entry names it and says why, and it is kept as history. Decisions already deprecated with an integrated cut stay deprecated. The journal's views show only standing decisions, and history only when asked.
